title: Qatar Emir calls PM Modi over Ras Laffan blast deaths
summary: The Amir of Qatar contacted Prime Minister Narendra Modi to express condolences following the death of twelve Indians in a gas plant explosion in Ras Al-Lafan. Both nations stated they are supporting affected families.
summary_points: Qatar's Emir called Indian PM Modi regarding deaths at Ras Laffan.
